info.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365
info.description: Authentication: OAuth 2.0 (client credentials grant, Azure AD application user). Microsoft Dynamics 365 is Microsoft's business applications suite built on Dataverse; this spec targets the Dataverse Web API's core Sales/Customer Service entities. This spec broadens the curated CRUD surface (accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, incidents/cases) with activity and identity operations Microsoft's Web API reference documents as part of the same standard, org-independent surface: task (activity) CRUD, read-only system user lookups, the WhoAmI identity function, and the $metadata CSDL document.

post.description: Sends multiple GET, or a changeset of Create/Update/Delete, operations to Dataverse in a single HTTP request. The body is a multipart/mixed payload; each individual write request must be wrapped in a changeset so it's processed as a single transaction (all succeed or none do). Batches are limited to 1000 individual requests.

schema.description: Raw multipart/mixed batch body containing one or more individual HTTP requests (and changesets for writes), each separated by the request's boundary marker.

200.description: Multipart/mixed response containing one HTTP response per individual request in the batch

get.description: Returns the SystemUserId, BusinessUnitId, and OrganizationId of the identity the current connection authenticates as.
Returns the full CSDL (Conceptual Schema Definition Language) XML document describing every entity, attribute, and relationship in this environment, including any custom entities and fields.

ODataMaxVersion.name: OData-MaxVersion
ODataMaxVersion.description: Maximum OData version the client supports. Always 4.0 for the Dataverse Web API.

ODataVersion.name: OData-Version
ODataVersion.description: OData version of the request body/query. Always 4.0 for the Dataverse Web API.

select.name: $select
select.description: Comma-separated list of properties to return, e.g. name,revenue

filter.name: $filter
filter.description: OData filter expression, e.g. revenue gt 1000000

expand.name: $expand
expand.description: Related entities to include inline via a navigation property, e.g. primarycontactid($select=fullname)

top.name: $top
top.description: Maximum number of rows to return (Dataverse returns up to 5000 rows without this)

count.name: $count
count.description: When true, includes an @odata.count of the total matching rows alongside the page of results

Prefer.name: Prefer
Prefer.description: Set to return=representation to have Create/Update return the resulting record body instead of 204 No Content
